outcome: Make writing discovery metadata-only, render only the requested article, and collect referenced assets without archive rendering while preserving fresh reads and publishing safeguards.
boundary: Indexes, feeds, sitemap and article static parameters do not render Markdown bodies; detail lookup reads and renders only its validated collection/slug.
Full corpus validation, including drafts, remains in content:check/build. Preview reads edits/additions/deletions without a persistent cache.
Image access remains an explicit referenced-raster allowlist with shared Markdown reference parsing, collection containment, type/size/symlink checks and draft filtering.
Preserve existing archive migration, native reading output and static production routes. No dependencies, content edits, external writes, commit or deployment.
ownerInput: Independent boundary/final reviewer unavailable through the exposed tools; do not fabricate approval.
outOfScope: Unrelated physical-device, browser-chrome zoom and screen-reader audit
